summary.name: VoxSail
summary.one_liner: VoxSail is an AI video localization platform that transcribes, translates, subtitles, and dubs videos and audio into other languages in one browser-based workflow.
use_cases: Translate YouTube creator videos into other languages
Localize product demos and ads for global markets
Create multilingual course and onboarding videos
Generate translated subtitles with aligned timing
Dub video or audio with AI voices or cloned voices
summary.what_it_does: VoxSail detects speech in uploaded videos or audio, generates transcripts and subtitles, and translates source and subtitle text into target languages. It can produce AI dubbing with preset voices, original-voice cloning, or a user-created cloned voice, with attention to rhythm and pauses. A browser-based editor lets users edit source and translated subtitles, adjust timing and subtitle styles, and regenerate dubbing per segment. Projects are exported after review, and the page says it supports a glossary-style consistency for product names and terms.
notable: Subtitle, translation, and dubbing managed in one editor with bilingual review
Voice cloning that matches speech rate and pauses (only with voice material you own or have permission to use)
Claims 130+ supported languages, though speech recognition, translation, and voices do not cover the same languages
Text edits do not auto-retranslate or regenerate audio; steps must be rerun and exported again
caveats: Uses subscriptions and credits; cost depends on duration or character count, target languages, dubbing method, and exports
Language and voice coverage varies by tool and selected voice
Voice cloning results depend on recording clarity and noise
